# Marketing In Action

> An execution-first marketing community helping marketers and founders unlock predictable revenue.

Marketing In Action (MIA) is a marketing ecosystem providing education, resources, job opportunities, and consulting services for marketers and founders focused on go-to-market (GTM) execution.

## Site Structure

- [Homepage](https://marketinginaction.xyz/): Overview of the MIA ecosystem and offerings
- [MIA Academy — For Marketers in Tech](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/): Courses, bootcamps, and hands-on learning programs for marketers
- [MIA Academy — For SME Business Owners](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/): Marketing workshops, bundles, and done-for-you services for Nigerian business owners
- [MIA Services](https://marketinginaction.xyz/services/): Overview of ways to work with MIA — product marketing & GTM for software companies, and done-for-you paid acquisition for local, ecommerce, and creator businesses
- [Product Marketing & GTM](https://marketinginaction.xyz/consulting/): Fractional product marketing, advisory, and GTM execution for software and SaaS companies
- [Paid Acquisition](https://marketinginaction.xyz/acquisition/): Done-for-you paid acquisition systems (paid ads, AI-generated creative, and content) for service businesses, ecommerce brands, and online creators
- [MIA Jobs](https://marketinginaction.xyz/jobs/): Marketing job board for hiring and job seekers
- [MIA Resources](https://marketinginaction.xyz/resources/): Templates, tools, and marketing resources
- [MIA Newsletter](https://newsletter.marketinginaction.xyz/): Weekly marketing insights and strategies

## MIA Academy — For SME Business Owners

Workshops with video walkthroughs, templates, and done-for-you services for Nigerian SME business owners.

- [Online Marketing Consulting (Done-For-You)](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/consulting/): Full marketing execution — ads, pages, automation, reporting. ₦150,000/month.
- [Online Marketing Mentorship](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/bundle/): 3-month marketing mentorship covering 5 systems. Workshops, implementation support, and private WhatsApp access. ₦45,000.
- [Meta Ads Simplified](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/meta-ads/): Step-by-step Meta Ads workshop with video walkthroughs. ₦15,000.
- [TikTok Ads Simplified](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/tiktok-ads/): Complete TikTok Ads workshop including Nigerian card workaround. ₦15,000.
- [Business Page Optimization](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/page-optimization/): Instagram and TikTok page optimization workshop. ₦15,000.
- [Social Automation Simplified](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/automation/): ManyChat and Meta DM automation workshop. ₦15,000.
- [Safety Net (Account Protection)](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/sme/safety-net/): Account protection workshop for Facebook, Instagram, and ad accounts. ₦15,000.

## MIA Academy — For Marketers in Tech

Courses, bootcamps, and resources for Nigerian marketers targeting remote USD roles.

- [Product & Growth Marketing with AI — Bootcamp](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/pro-bootcamp/): 12-week execution-first bootcamp. Pro ₦75,000 / Core ₦45,000.
- [The Complete Product Marketing Course](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/pmm-course/): 10-module PMM course with 100+ page handbook. ₦15,000.
- [The Complete Tech Sales Course](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/tech-sales/): 7-module SaaS sales course. ₦15,000.
- [PMM Templates & Resources Library](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/templates/): 24+ premium templates, updated monthly. ₦20,000/year.
- [AI Prompt Frameworks for Marketers](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/ai-prompts/): 40+ production-ready AI prompt templates. ₦20,000.
- [Growth Marketing Handbook](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/growth-handbook/): AARRR framework, experiment templates, growth playbooks. ₦10,000.
- [Digital Marketing Guide](https://marketinginaction.xyz/academy/digital-marketing/): 7 digital channels, 200+ term glossary. ₦5,000.

## Free Guides

- [Claude Code for Marketers](https://marketinginaction.xyz/resources/claude-code-for-marketers/): Free guide for marketers to set up Claude Code, install marketing skills, and use AI for positioning, GTM strategy, landing pages, and more. No coding experience needed.
- [The Paid Acquisition Playbook](https://marketinginaction.xyz/resources/paid-ads-playbook/): Free interactive playbook for paid acquisition across the major paid channels. Covers onboarding, tracking, strategy, structure, audiences, creative, budget, launch, optimization, reporting, and scaling. Includes checklists, calculators, naming generators, and copy-ready templates.

## Key Topics

- Go-to-market (GTM) strategy
- Product marketing and positioning
- Growth marketing and experimentation
- AI-assisted marketing execution
- Meta Ads and TikTok Ads for Nigerian businesses
- Social media automation and DM management
- Marketing careers and remote USD opportunities
- B2B SaaS marketing

## About

Marketing In Action was created by James Praise, a product marketing and GTM operator who has worked across Africa, North America, and Europe as a first or early marketing hire, contributing to $10M+ in qualified pipeline and supporting 15+ product launches. Named one of APMP's Top 20 Marketing Leaders in Africa. Holds an MBA in Entrepreneurship & Innovation and a Product Marketing Management Certification (PMMC). Has trained over 5,000 marketers and business owners.
